text: We had all the documents signed by a lawyer including the one that your landlord had to fill up. I up loaded all theses documents to the link where it said extra documents. In the final interview she asked for the documents and I told her I uploaded it to the link. She checked it and said it is good. It is unclear why they ask for all theses documents and don’t tell you where to upload it. If you didn’t do it just bring it to the interview.
